context: US county choropleth election swing map with linked brushable histogram, showing margins and year-over-year swing for 5 synthetic elections (2008–2024) with a year slider and play animation.
first_impression: Structurally honest diverging choropleth with correct color direction and zero-baseline histogram bars, but brittle hardcoded domains create silent data truncation.
what_works: Diverging color scale correctly uses scaleDiverging with a symmetric ±30 domain and clamp, matching the disclosed legend bounds; histogram bars start at zero with a data-driven y-domain via d3.max.
what_doesnt: Histogram x-domain is hardcoded to [-20, 20] causing silent exclusion of swing values outside that range with no overflow bin or warning; choropleth domain is also hardcoded at ±30 rather than derived from d3.extent of actual margins, so both fail the scaling metamorphic relation.
